Dear Dr Hassan,

Re: Mrs Elena Petrova, DO 8 September 1968

Thank you for reviewing Mrs Petrova, whose type 2 diabetes remains stable on metformin 1g twice daily with HbA1c 6.8% last month. She reports no hypoglycaemic episodes. Blood pressure today 128/78 mmHg.

I would be grateful if you could see her for her annual diabetic foot review in approximately four weeks, as the community podiatry service has a waiting list.

Yours sincerely,
Dr Okafor
